g.text: - Areas in m2 with sq ft alongside; plot area also in gaj (1 gaj = 1 sq yd = 9 sq ft). All lengths in millimetres.
- No FAR rule applied, so no FAR allowance is stated.
- No coverage rule applied, so no coverage allowance is stated.
- Permissible and required figures are the compliance engine's results for the rule packs loaded, cited by rule id in REMARKS. This sheet does not recompute them.
- Rule-pack values carry a confidence grade and must be verified against the sanctioning authority's bye-laws in force before submission.
